connector.name: Search by aimnis
connector.registryDescription: Collaborative, cache-first web search for agents - cited answers from a shared live-web pool.
connector.summary: Hosted at aimnis.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aimnis account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer aim_YOUR_KEY — get a free eval key at https://aimnis.com/register (delivered by email).
